analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,373,000 KRW) vs SMA5 (1,579,800 KRW) / SMA20 (1,926,400 KRW) / SMA50 (2,169,861 KRW) — below short/mid-term trend, bearish.
· Position relative to SMA100 (1,674,202 KRW) / SMA200 (1,168,147 KRW) — mid/long-term trend weakening, above SMA200.
· 52-week position (38.9%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.0→32.7) — entered oversold, downward momentum continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (hist -52740.3241→-65169.5135) — worsening, bearish trend strengthening.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (near lower band 1,366,797 KRW) — approaching lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (913,667 KRW) — based on Pivot S1, next support if price falls.
· Swing resistance (1,995,000 KRW) — based on previous high, trend reversal expected upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower Low) — confirms bearish trend continuation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.81x) — subdued volume, reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend) — high probability of further decline, hence observing.
